description: R0-20-MARKPAID-CONVERGENCE: conformance of the landed R0-PL-04-MARK-PAID-POSTS-LEDGER behaviour (335e1e09, review repairs e9bf3697, merged a53c6206; D-05 default: mark-paid without an amount records the remaining balance) to the R0-20 proof (M27, CF-09). Run from apps/server against a migrated isolated database and REDIS_URL: npx vitest run test/payments-mark-paid.integration.test.ts test/webhooks.controller.test.ts test/commerce.service.test.ts --no-file-parallelism --reporter=json --outputFile=<report>, then node ../../scripts/proof-admission/evaluate.mjs --manifest ../../scripts/proof-admission/manifests/mark-paid-convergence.json --report <report> (or node scripts/proof-admission/run-manifests.mjs --only mark-paid-convergence.json from the repo root). R0-20 claim to case map. RED-BEFORE (c2f6f46d: markInvoicePaid at 719 flipped PAID and wrote a synthetic manual_<id>_<Date.now()> SUCCESSFUL row at 775-787 with no posting): fixed by R0-PL-04 before this packet, so every case below is a regression control; against a temporary revert of that body MP-01..03, MP-05, MP-06s (then titled MP-06), MP-07, MP-09..17, MP-18, MP-20a, MP-20b and MP-L1 fail. GREEN-AFTER: one SUCCESSFUL payment for the remaining balance through recordPayment with one Payment:<id>:payment_recorded posting and PAID (MP-01, MP-06s, MP-07; MP-18 spies recordPayment); after 100 of 250 a 150 balancing payment and a later reconcile keeps PAID (MP-18; 60 of 100 in MP-02); PAID is a no-op (MP-03); two concurrent calls give one payment and one posting (MP-09; races MP-10, MP-11); DRAFT 409 (MP-04); a foreign tenant gets 404 under its own tenant (403 naming A, 403 with no tenant) and the Payment table, read by raw SQL because Payment is outside the tenant extension (M31), holds no row for A's invoice and none in B (MP-19); the same refusals hold on an invoice of A that is already PAID, so the idempotent PAID return (commerce.service.ts markInvoicePaid) can not run ahead of the tenant and membership checks: B gets the unknown-id 404 with no invoice body (MP-19b), and KEY without a tenant gets 403 there too (MP-08b). An injected posting failure rolls back the payment and the status: the payment posting runs before the reconcile inside recordPayment's transaction, so a failure of the posting itself, after its rows were written (MP-20a) or before (MP-20b), strikes before the status is written and those cases show only that it never moved; MP-20c fails the COGS posting step of the in-transaction reconcile, after PAID, paidAt, the payment and its posting were written inside the same transaction, and shows payment, posting and status all rolled back to SENT. The packet text's idempotency key markpaid_<invoiceId> is superseded by the R0-PL-04 review repair ST-PL04-1/ST-PL04-2: the slot is server-built and random, manual_<inv>_markpaid_<hex32>, so no client key, reference or public callback row can capture it (MP-13, MP-14, MP-18); concurrency is serialized by the invoice lock instead. LEDGER: debits equal credits for every transaction of both tenants, reversals included (MP-L2, and per case in expectPostedOnce); deposit-side ledger cash net = sum(SUCCESSFUL) = computeBalance.paid per invoice (MP-18..MP-20b inline, and MP-L1 over every fixture invoice: each case owns its invoice, so its end state is the state after that case). MP-L1 leaves out the refund-bearing fixtures of the R0-PL-04 review (MP-05, MP-12a, MP-12b: M28 refund semantics are V1-29) and the direct-write race and provider stand-ins (MP-10, MP-11, MP-15), which carry no posting by construction. Legacy Stripe caller, R0-20b-LEGACY-STRIPE-WEBHOOK-DOOR (D-05, ruled 2026-11-02: the bounded change to the legacy handler is authorized and RA-G16-01 leaves deferral): POST /webhooks/stripe verifies the Stripe signature as before and hands the verified bytes to the Stripe ledger door (PaymentsService.handleStripeWebhook, what POST /payments/stripe/webhook runs: provider-event dedupe, createPaymentWithPosting, the reconcile), after refusing (400, nothing recorded, no dedupe claim) a payment event of an invoice whose metadata.businessId or currency is not the invoice's or whose amount is missing or not positive, and one of a storefront order that does not name the order (metadata.orderId) and its business or does not carry exactly its total in its currency (the door settles an order for its whole total); it never calls markInvoicePaid. MP-06 (the former KNOWN DEFECT it.todo, CR-R020-2) is conforming: one SUCCESSFUL provider 'stripe' payment with the session id and the amount and currency the event carries, recordedBy null, posted once Dr PAYMENT_PROCESSOR (no CASH entry), PAID, markInvoicePaid never called, a redelivery on the legacy route or on the door writes nothing, deprecated:true and the use hint kept; MP-06b the reverse order (door first); MP-06c the refusals, an unsigned or wrongly signed call refused as before and an event type the door ignores acknowledged as before. R0-20b review repairs: SEC-R020B-1 (blocking): an id that is not an invoice went to the door unbound, and the door settles a storefront order for its whole total, so a Payment Link session of another tenant pointed at the order by a payer-supplied client_reference_id settled it; MP-06d (StoreOrderService.updatePaymentStatus a recording stub) refuses that and every session not naming the order, its business, its currency or exactly its total, and settles the order's own session once. CR-R020B-1: the exact-total refusal for invoices is gone, so a session paid after the invoice total was edited is recorded for the amount it carries, once, whichever endpoint gets it first (MP-06e). SEC-R020B-3: each refusal is kept as one webhook_events row, provider stripe-legacy-refused, the invoice's or order's business, event type <type>:<reason>; a retry adds none (MP-06c, MP-06d). CR-R020B-2: the Stripe connector's payment.received is emitted again, once, when the door processed the event for an invoice, with the recorded amount (MP-06, MP-06b, MP-06e and the WebhooksController CR-R020B-2 case). SEC-R020B-2 (the door's own endpoint does not apply the binding) is the visible it.todo MP-06g: payments.service.ts is outside the write set. RED-BEFORE for the repairs (keyflowos_w6, the packet head c2be0416 controller): MP-06, MP-06c, MP-06d, MP-06e and the two new WebhooksController cases failed. D-05: the amount recorded is always the one the event carries (no remaining-balance default on the webhook path). RED-BEFORE for R0-20b (its tests-first commit 7260b33b on the unmodified handler, keyflowos_w8, --no-file-parallelism): MP-06, MP-06b, MP-06c and the WebhooksController stripe case failed; every other case of the two suites passed. MP-06s is the former MP-06 retitled, its assertion unchanged: the service shape markInvoicePaid(invoiceId) itself still takes the posted path, and no production caller passes it any more (revenue-auth-001 RA-G16-01 census; refusing the direct call is the RA-G16-01 service-half it.todo there). The WebhooksController stripe case keeps its title; its assertion is now the R0-20b contract (the door is handed the verified raw body and the signature, markInvoicePaid is not called, deprecated:true and the use hint), the old one pinned the defect. The CommerceService markInvoicePaid unit cases stay green. allowAdditionalCases is true for the rest of the two legacy unit files. Fixture prefix k20a_ (registry unchanged).
